# The Family Ground

> A membership for parents: track chores, write family agreements together, and take short courses. Built by Amam, a dad of six, who tries things in his own home and shares honestly.

- Home: https://thefamilyground.com/
- Become a member: https://thefamilyground.com/signup.html
- Log in: https://thefamilyground.com/login.html
- Kid login: https://thefamilyground.com/kid-login.html
- Blog and newsletter: https://blog.thefamilyground.com

## What it is

The Family Ground is a parent membership site. Members get:

- A chore tracker for the whole week.
- A family agreement builder the whole family fills in together.
- Short courses inside the membership.
- A kids' side: each kid gets their own simple dashboard. Kids join with a one-time code from their parent — no email address or phone number needed. Parents assign chores, kids mark them done (with an optional photo), and parents approve or ask them to try again.

## What it is not

- The family agreement is an experiment Amam is trying in his own home, not a proven method.
- Course outlines are drafts awaiting review, not finished lessons.
- Membership pricing is not set yet; founding member pricing will be announced at launch.
- There are no testimonials, statistics, or claimed results on this site.

## Who makes it

Amam Nazar, a dad of six. He does not present himself as a parenting expert or guru.
